versions.changelog:
## Added
- The supported model table now lists gemini-2.5-flash-lite for text-only requests through Gemini contents and the OpenAI, Responses and Anthropic Messages compatibility protocols; image, audio and file input are rejected.
- The supported model table now lists gemini-3.1-flash-lite for text-only requests through Gemini contents and the OpenAI, Responses and Anthropic Messages compatibility protocols; image, audio and file input are rejected.

## Added
- List gemini-3.5-flash-lite for text requests through Chat Completions and native Gemini content generation.
- Gemini 3.8 Flash (gemini-3.8-flash) is now listed as an available text-only Gemini model with function calling.

## Added
- Document Gemini 3.7 Flash native streaming and OpenAI-compatible streaming with terminal usage verification.

## Changed
- Document Gemini authentication, request, result verification, and stop boundaries in the primary recipe, with compatibility protocols loaded only when required.

## Changed
- Complete marketplace distribution for the RunAPI Gemini skill.

## Added
- Document gemini-3.6-flash for OpenAI-compatible Chat and Gemini native content streaming.

## Removed
- Remove `gemini-3-pro-preview` from the supported Gemini model list.
  Migration: Choose another currently supported model ID; no replacement alias is provided.

## Changed
- Publish the Gemini skill v0.2.10 release with refreshed RunAPI routing metadata.

## Changed
- Supported models table simplified to model + capabilities; protocol support (OpenAI-compatible + Gemini contents) is described in the request-styles section.

## Changed
- Supported models table is now generated from the RunAPI catalog.
- Corrected `gemini-3.5-flash` Chat Completions support and refreshed model ordering.

## Changed
- Clarify Gemini contents support and native versus bridged streaming behavior.
